findings: The scan-frame support gate removes the conspicuous off-scan and floating CAD axes present in the raw CAD output.
Most surviving axes lie on visible outer edges or flange transitions and are geometrically plausible as bend evidence.
10839000_01_full_scan remains over-segmented around the rectangular frame.
40500000_0_SCAN2 contains an implausible long interior-spanning proposal.
Partial 38172000 scans remain under-covered, and endpoint placement is inconsistent around short local features.
The artifacts support a bounded scan-plus-CAD development experiment, but not production release or a claim of complete bend recovery.
